# hvrg_page (Resource)

The page records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references
- `name` (String) display name

### Optional

- `description` (String) what the page shows
- `icon` (String) icon name shown in the sidebar
- `is_fullscreen` (Boolean) true when the page renders without the app shell
- `layout` (Dynamic) grid mode and size: mode dynamic or fixed, rows and columns
- `owner_id` (String) owning organization
- `parent_id` (String) the page this one is a sub page of
- `style` (String) CSS applied to the page
- `variables` (Dynamic) variable definitions the views of the page read, as a list
